subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: If the drive process dies mid-await (crash, laptop closed), then the system shall lose nothing permanently: on next start, awaits re-derive from durable state and the first check reconciles reality
intent: the restarted drive continues; no duplicate proposals
fit_criterion: kill/restart drill on both media: continuation with zero duplicates (rides prd:implement-now FR-14)
